claim_boundary: Retrospective 27-growth method-development LOO after domain-expert exclusion of erroneous growth 6081. Every displayed growth target and every AFM texture/island fit excludes the displayed growth in its outer fold. N6342 motivated renderer development, so its result is retrospective development evidence rather than a prospective untouched-test claim.

confidence.confidence_definition: Smoothed survival percentile of equal-weight ranks of strictly cross-fitted expected FSMI and island-topology errors. FSMI already contains height amplitude, so Rq is not double-counted.

protocol: retrospective nested leave-one-growth-out over the fixed harmonized 27-growth cohort
